programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Kumar finds a puzzle etched onto a human skull in his late grandfather's belongings. He consults Bimal, his friend, to solve it, and together they set out on a treasure hunt in a jungle.

programme.title: Pathbhola
programme.desc: Five rebellious young men, who work under a corrupt businessman, kill a police officer. They manage to evade, but their lives completely change when they learn a shocking truth.

programme.title: Sangram
programme.desc: When buried hostilities between two families resurface, a young man finds himself torn between romance and the painful legacy of betrayal.

programme.title: Agni
programme.desc: A good cop becomes the target of terrorists, but they accidentally kill schoolchildren on a bus. This tragic mistake leaves the police deeply worried about rising crime.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Shubhankar falls for Puja and manages to win her love after relentless pursuits. However, things take a complicated turn when Puja's brother decides to kill Shubhankar.

programme.title: One
programme.desc: An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.

programme.title: Bagha Jatin
programme.desc: Jatindranath Mukherjee plays a central role in the revolutionary struggle against colonial rule. He is revered for his leadership and dedication in India's quest for freedom.

programme.title: Rong Beronger Korhi
programme.desc: An anthology of four short stories portraying the impact of money on relationships characterised by different nuances of emotions.

programme.title: Daal Bati Churma Chacchori
programme.desc: After breaking up with his non-Bengali girlfriend, Anand's life takes a turn when Barsha, a Bengali girl, enters the picture, sparking a new romance.

programme.title: Cancer
programme.desc: Three siblings share a bitter relationship with each other after they suspect that their father is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Ami Sudhu Tor Holam
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with the granddaughter of a retired colonel. When he decides to confess his love, he feels heartbroken upon discovering her relationship with another man.

programme.title: Ami Sudhu Tor Holam

programme.title: Love Express
programme.desc: When Raktim misses his train, he's forced to spend the night at the station. However, he encounters Nilasha, a mysterious woman who sweeps him into a thrilling adventure that alters his life forever.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Amader Janani
programme.desc: A woman raises her sons with great difficulty and bears the financial burden of the family when her husband meets with an accident. However, things get ugly when both her sons deceive her.

programme.title: Jamaibabu Zindabad
programme.desc: Kajol, a managing director, and Sagar, the chief mechanic at a private firm, are always at loggerheads. A series of events bring them closer hinting at ending their mutual animosity.

programme.title: Haami
programme.desc: Bhutu and Chini become best friends after the latter takes admission in a co-educational school. However, their innocence and friendship fall prey to their parents' judgements.

programme.title: Kirtan

programme.title: Karnasubarner Guptodhon
programme.desc: The cheerful vacation of Sona Da, Abir and Jhinuk turns into a treacherous pursuit of the coveted treasures of King Shashanka.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Finding solace in magic, Indra keeps his problems at bay. However, his life takes a turn when he meets Kirti and their connection unveils a past life story.

programme.title: Krishnakanter Will
programme.desc: Haralal finds out that his cousin, Gobindalal, holds a higher share in his father's property. So, he conspires to have the will replaced by forging his father's signature.

programme.title: Golmaal
programme.desc: Pralay, Mainak and Khushi are given shelter by Kaka Babu. Pralay falls for Chandni, the daughter of a local don, and Mainak loves Sangeeta, but he soon discovers that she loves Pralay.

programme.title: Pushpa Impossible
programme.desc: After doing various odd jobs, an uneducated woman from Gujarat starts a business to earn a living and attempts to keep her family happy.

In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Street racing in the US is the subject of this docu-reality series, which purportedly provides an inside look into the action both on the road and behind the scenes. In Oklahoma City, for example, racers boast having the fastest street cars in the country, and the racing, they say, comes first - before family, before friends and before work. From a 1969 Chevy Nova to a race-ready farm truck, the vehicles - and their drivers - come in all shapes and sizes and have one thing in common: the need for speed.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch.

programme.title: Dirt Every Day
programme.desc: Exploring and going on off-road adventures, in a wide variety of different vehicles.

programme.title: Dirt Every Day
programme.desc: Exploring and going on off-road adventures, in a wide variety of different vehicles.

programme.title: Seduced by Speed
programme.desc: Building fast cars takes guts, grit, madness, power, and vision, and the endeavour sometimes result in scandals that rock the automotive industry and the world.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan
programme.desc: Armed with several years' worth of mechanical expertise, Mike Finnegan and his robust friends never shy away from fulfilling challenging tasks.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars

Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. programme.title: You Have Been Warned Again
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned Again
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programme.desc: As Steve Rogers tries to adapt to the modern world, he forges new alliances and faces a threat that turns out to be an old friend.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

programme.title: Jurassic City
programme.desc: After the security of a top-secret laboratory is compromised, genetically modified dinosaurs get unleashed. Then, a black-ops unit is tasked with capturing the creatures before they cause more damage.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Bryan Mills goes on the run after being wrongly accused of murder, using his skills to stay ahead of the law and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Two siblings find an eerie board game after moving into their new house. While playing it, they release a man, who has been trapped in it for 26 years, and dangers from the jungle.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: Ella, a young woman, lives with her abusive stepmother, who treats her as the maid of the house. However, things change for the better when she encounters Kit, a young palace apprentice.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: An unusually talented rat who can cook forms an alliance with a young chef from a famous restaurant in Paris. Soon, their uncommon bond creates chaos.

programme.title: Avatar
programme.desc: Jake, who has paraplegia, replaces his twin on the Na'vi-inhabited Pandora for a corporate mission. After the natives accept him as one of their own, he must decide where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat together where they must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Tony Stark, a brilliant inventor, gets kidnapped by terrorists while working on a project overseas. He builds a high-tech armour in order to escape and later uses it to save people.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: A crew of space colonisers boards a derelict station in search of valuable resources. Their routine scavenging mission becomes a fight for survival against a deadly entity.

programme.title: Gladiator II
programme.desc: With his homeland in the clutches of the despotic rulers of Rome, Lucius must find the strength to survive the Colosseum and fight the emperors' tyranny.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
programme.desc: Captain Jack Sparrow and Will Turner team up to rescue Elizabeth from Barbossa's cursed crew while navigating treacherous waters and supernatural dangers.

programme.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
programme.desc: Captain Jack Sparrow and Will Turner team up to rescue Elizabeth from Barbossa's cursed crew while navigating treacherous waters and supernatural dangers.

programme.title: Lake Placid: Legacy
programme.desc: A team of explorers set out to unearth the secrets behind an abandoned facility. Once inside the facility, they are dragged into a battle for their lives with a deadly predator.

programme.title: Ghost Shark
programme.desc: After a great white shark devours a fisherman's potential catch, he and his daughter kill it in retaliation. However, the shark returns as a ghost, seeking vengeance on the town of Smallport.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: Michelle accepts a professional role suggested by her advisor. This position confines her within a residence where three deranged relatives attempt to cleanse her soul.

programme.title: Catch The Dragon
programme.desc: A palaeontology expert embarks on a quest with a skilled hunter and a mechanic to hunt dragons and uncover the truth about his father's death.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: A team of commandos led by a Vietnam War veteran is sent to rescue hostages in a Central American jungle. They soon discover that they are being hunted by a deadly creature.

programme.title: Turning Red
programme.desc: Facing a dilemma about her future, a thirteen-year-old girl's life becomes extremely exciting when she turns into a giant red panda.

programme.title: Home Alone
programme.desc: Eight-year-old Kevin is accidentally left behind when his family leaves for France. At first, he is happy to be in charge, but when thieves try to break into his home, he tries to put up a fight.

programme.title: Tomorrowland

programme.title: Sense The VIbe Bro!
programme.desc: Avi and Meera come to visit Riya and Varun. But they arrive having had a fight. What starts off as an awkward situation turns into a nightmare for our exes.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: Tanha
programme.desc: Ria starts to look for new houses. Back in the day, Ria and Varun are still dealing with their broken trust, and everything changes.

programme.title: Darmaan
programme.desc: Varun and Ria break up.

programme.title: Hum
programme.desc: Varun and Ria try and make their relationship work.

programme.title: Feels Like Responsibility
programme.desc: As Avi and Lakshay prepare for their "first second house party", Avi's dad decides to drop in for a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Sameer tries to think of different ways to get his unwanted roommate Gandhi to shift to the living room instead. Will their first second party go as planned?

programme.title: Feels Like Give and Take
programme.desc: After weeks of witnessing the boys make a mess of Bancchod Niwas, Sameer tells them to clean up their act. Lakshay's solution is? Get a housekeeper. Meanwhile, Avi, still reeling from his breakup with Mahima, decides to make a "grand gesture", which also inspires Lakshay to get another quirky roommate.

programme.title: Feels Like Summer
programme.desc: As the Delhi heat rises in full force, tempers rise with it. Sameer tries to push himself to perform his poetry for an audience that isn't Lloyd, while Avi tries to drown his sorrows by pretending like he's completely fine. Tensions implode and so do Gandhi's... special parts.

programme.title: Feels Like Finding Yourself
programme.desc: Avi has the greatest plan (his words) to move on and spend time with himself - an Imtiaz Ali-themed tour of Delhi. What could go wrong? Meanwhile, Gandhi's first day of cricket practice doesn't quite go as planned, and Lakshay meets an unexpected acquaintance.

programme.title: Feels Like Family
programme.desc: The boys are at Lakshay's family home for his sister's wedding. As Avi and Gandhi gear up to get lucky, Sameer has a significant revelation. Lakshay, meanwhile, feels out of the loop with his own family, as he feels replaced by his nemesis John. The wedding weekend rages with the promise of chaos and drama.

programme.title: Feels Like Choices
programme.desc: The exam results of last semester are out and Avi's is less than perfect. Afraid to let his dad find out in case he is called back home, Avi cooks up a drastic plan with the help of Sameer and Gandhi. Meanwhile, Lakshay hosts a Fresher's party, where he comes to point of no return. Will the boys make the right choices?

programme.title: No Way Up
programme.desc: Characters from different backgrounds are thrown together when the plane they're travelling on crashes into the Pacific Ocean. A nightmare fight for survival ensues with the air supply running out and dangers creeping in from all sides.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: A fever dream action film that follows Boy, a deaf person with a vibrant imagination. When his family is murdered, he is trained by a mysterious shaman to repress his childish imagination and become an instrument of death.

programme.title: Feels Like Fixing Yourself
programme.desc: Gandhi having been injured at the end of season 1, is still grappling with not making it to the tryouts. But the problem may not be physical as much as it is mental. As the boys try their own methods to help Gandhi feel better, Lakshay tries to figure out ways to tell Avi about Mahima. Will the boys be successful in helping Gandhi heal?

programme.title: Feels Like Fear
programme.desc: Sameer's 20th birthday approaches and he realises that he isn't even close to achieving his goals in life. To help find answers, he calls Vicky Paaji to try a new drug called "Kadak Chai". The boys and Vicky Paaji take the chai together and go on different trips and face their fears of unintended consequences.

programme.title: Feels Like Rock Bottom
programme.desc: A single-take episode right after the events of the party where Avi finds out about Lakshay and Mahima, a fight breaks out between the boys as they deal with their own fears and the problems they have with each other. Will this be the end of their friendship?

programme.title: Feels Like Acceptance
programme.desc: Tensions in the house are at an all-time high. In the middle of this, Vicky Paaji comes home unannounced and starts to stay with the boys. The boys must now team up to kick Vicky Paaji out.

programme.title: The Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Ruhi needs a new phone and a scholarship, but also wants Lucky’s attention. Kenny wants to stand up for his rights but desperately needs help for the same.

programme.title: The Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Ruhi has second thoughts about her choices. Ayesha needs a story at any cost. Aparna is looking for payback. Meanwhile, Aditya makes some progress with the investigation.

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Bhati and Gagan face off in a surprisingly close-fought election. Ruhi has a close shave in an outstation exam. Tarush suffers a setback.

programme.title: Brave New World
programme.desc: Ruhi gets a taste of the good life, briefly, before the shit hits the fan. Tarush takes matters into his own hands. Aparna needs to regain control of her show. Bijoy smells a rat.

programme.desc: Bhati overcommits to a sponsor and faces a logistical nightmare. Tarush follows the breadcrumbs. Everyone crosses paths at the college festival. Well, almost.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.title: Life Of A Predator
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: Surviving Australia
programme.desc: Survivors recount harrowing escapes from the Australian outback, while experts dismantle common myths to provide the raw tactics needed to stay alive.

programme.title: Deadliest Snakes of South Africa
programme.desc: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.desc: In a journey that follows lions for the first five years of their lives, uncover fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals and discover the threats against them, such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.title: The Hippo King
programme.desc: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home "Gator Country."

programme.title: The Savannah: Wild Happiness
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

programme.title: Nature's Fast Attacks
programme.desc: From camouflaged hunters to the lethally fast, the deadliest predators in the world use all sorts of abilities to gain an advantage over their prey and kill in a matter of moments.

programme.title: Bastion of the Giants
programme.desc: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra.

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

programme.title: Wolves: Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword.

programme.title: A Game Of Leopard Thrones
programme.desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

programme.desc: Krugers Wild Kingdom

programme.title: Deadliest Snakes of South Africa
programme.desc: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

programme.title: Tigress Blood
programme.desc: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.desc: In a journey that follows lions for the first five years of their lives, uncover fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals and discover the threats against them, such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.desc: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home "Gator Country."

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade is not a fisherman; he's an `extreme angler' in search of the biggest and most dangerous freshwater fish, the kind with a taste for human flesh. This action-adventure series also features Wade illustrating how these river monsters are constructed to kill.

programme.title: Nature's Fast Attacks
programme.desc: From camouflaged hunters to the lethally fast, the deadliest predators in the world use all sorts of abilities to gain an advantage over their prey and kill in a matter of moments.

programme.title: Bastion of the Giants

programme.title: Lions versus Hyenas
programme.desc: Although scientists have studied the ecology of African predators for years, few animals are as cliché in the general perception as lions and hyenas: the 'noble kings of the savannah' on the one hand, and the 'cowardly scavengers' on the other.

programme.title: Snow Leopards with Dan O'Neill
programme.desc: Set against Kyrgyzstan's rugged mountains, Dan O'Neill embarks on a mission to protect one of the world's most elusive creatures: the snow leopard. Following Dan as he works to build a new research centre dedicated to studying these majestic cats.

programme.title: Wolves: Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword.

programme.title: A Game Of Leopard Thrones
programme.desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

programme.title: Deadliest Snakes of South Africa

programme.title: Tigress Blood
programme.desc: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey.

programme.title: Natural Born Monsters
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. programme.title: You Have Been Warned Again
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: Dr Emma Craythorne and her team of experts are on a mission to solve complex skin conditions. They help people whose lives have been impeded by devastating disorders, and these patients hope Emma and her team have the solution.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.desc:
Four girls are kidnapped while returning from a rave party. They were drunk and driving rashly. They wake up to find themselves tied up in a secluded and unkempt bunglow. There is a fifth girl who has been tortured since long. Brutally beaten. The torture begins for these 4 girls. The man and woman who keep them hostage have CCTVs installed in the room where these girls are kept. Thus whenever they try to run away, or make any move are captured back. These goes on for days and then one day the kidnapper kills one of the girl's and feeds her to his dog, as she finds out that her husband has also been killed by the same man.
Later, the woman assisting the kidnapper reveals his story to these girls. The kidnapper had a sister, and she gets killed by a rash driving. Thus anyone who is driving irresponsibly will have to pay the price.
Towards the end these 3 girls manage to escape and reach their homes, only to discover that the kidnapper was actually one of the leading psychiatrist and was requested by their parents to treat the daughters from alcohol and drug abuse and addiction.
Since the traditional methods were tried earlier and lack of cooperation from patients yield no results, thus they reached out to this doctor.
Hence the doctor along with his colleagues & the two friends (whom were thought to have been killed) devise a 21 days treatment plan & everything was just part of it.

programme.title: Teri Meri Kahaani
programme.desc: True love blooms between a couple when destiny brings them together in several lifetimes, despite the trials and difficulties they face along the way.

programme.title: Ki & Ka
programme.desc: Kia, an ambitious woman, marries Kabir, a man who prefers the role of a house husband. They enjoy their unconventional relationship until challenges such as ego clashes and jealousy set in.

programme.title: Anwar Ka Ajab Kissa
programme.desc: A strange detective, who overindulges in the lives of his clients, confronts his reality when he is tasked to find Amol.

programme.title: Partner
programme.desc: A love expert helps a clumsy man win over his dream girl, only to face unexpected twists when he finds himself entangled in his own complicated romance.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Kashmir Daily
programme.desc: After doing thorough research, a reporter strives to bring to light the problems faced by the people of Jammu and Kashmir and showcase their plight with a different viewpoint.

programme.title: Bajatey Raho
programme.desc: After a trickster's deceptive activities result in the death and detainment of innocent lives, the desperate victims stop at nothing to avenge their misfortune.

programme.title: Dhuntaaraa
programme.desc: Four children go to a village during their vacation and find a new friend, Deepu. Together they learn about moral values and also solve an old mystery.

programme.title: Chalo Dilli
programme.desc: Stuck with an unsophisticated fellow traveller for hours after missing a flight, a high-society woman wends her way through diverse Indian neighbourhoods to reach Delhi.

programme.title: Un chef en terre inconnue
programme.desc: Les projets ne manquent pas dans la maison autonome de type géonef du chef Charles-Antoine Crête ; avec son ami Sébastien Deraspe, l'esprit créatif de Charles-Antoine se déploie, tant dans son ovni écologique que dans ses prestigieux restaurants.

programme.title: La cuisine d'Isabelle et Ricardo
programme.desc: La cheffe Isabelle Deschamps Plante poursuit la mission de Ricardo ; elle reçoit dans la même cuisine pour y préparer des recettes simples, réconfortantes et accessibles, trois jours par semaine.

programme.title: Pique-assiette
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet nous fait découvrir des plats ou produits du terroir cuisinés avec des ingrédients récoltés au fil des mois, même au cœur de l'hiver ; osso buco à l'ail des ours, choux, agrumes ; un impératif : retrouver la saveur des saisons.

programme.title: Épicerie fine
programme.desc: La découverte des produits phares de la gastronomie française et internationale.

programme.title: Très très bonne leçon
programme.desc: Comment ouvrir une huître ? Steak tartare : faut-il utiliser un hachoir ou un couteau ? Approuvé par des professionnels de renom, François-Régis Gaudry livre d'excellents conseils aux gourmets.

programme.title: Savourer
programme.desc: Savourer c'est déguster un plat, mais c'est aussi savourer un moment et profiter de la vie. La nutritionniste Geneviève O'Gleman partage son vaste arsenal de trucs et de recettes afin de passer moins de temps en cuisine et plus de temps à la table.

programme.title: Un chef en terre inconnue
programme.desc: Les projets ne manquent pas dans la maison autonome de type géonef du chef Charles-Antoine Crête ; avec son ami Sébastien Deraspe, l'esprit créatif de Charles-Antoine se déploie, tant dans son ovni écologique que dans ses prestigieux restaurants.

programme.desc: La découverte des produits phares de la gastronomie française et internationale.

programme.title: Très très bonne leçon
programme.desc: Comment ouvrir une huître ? Steak tartare : faut-il utiliser un hachoir ou un couteau ? Approuvé par des professionnels de renom, François-Régis Gaudry livre d'excellents conseils aux gourmets.

programme.title: Papilles
programme.desc: Itinéraire gourmand à travers la France, à la découverte de spécialités gourmandes et des artisans qui perpétuent leurs traditions culinaires. L'occasion de rencontrer un chef de talent pour préparer une recette régionale emblématique.

programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.

programme.title: Les saisons de pique-assiette
programme.desc: Annick Jeanmairet nous fait découvrir des plats ou produits du terroir cuisinés avec des ingrédients récoltés au fil des mois, même au cœur de l'hiver ; osso buco à l'ail des ours, choux, agrumes ; un impératif : retrouver la saveur des saisons.

programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.
